attchmntText: Elevate Campuses Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Elevate Campuses Limited filed an investor presentation regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported total income of Rs 2,474 Mn for Q2FY27, reflecting 28% year-on-year growth. EBITDA stood at Rs 1,696 Mn with a margin of 68.5%, showing 16% year-on-year growth. Normalised EBITDA was Rs 1,584 Mn. Reported profit after tax before exceptional items was Rs 330 Mn, a 16% decline year-on-year. Proforma cash profit after tax was Rs 781 Mn. The company listed on the NSE on September 30, 2026, raising Rs 21,000 Mn through its IPO. As of November 11, 2026, Rs 853 Mn of IPO proceeds remained unutilized. The presentation also highlighted operational metrics including 20,427 owned beds and 58,785 managed beds as of October 1, 2026.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report pursuant to Regulation 32 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
voiceSummary: Elevate Campuses Limited filed its Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with the National Stock Exchange and BSE. The report, issued by CARE Ratings Limited, confirms that the company raised Rs. 2,100 crore through its Initial Public Offer. The IPO period was from September 23, 2026, to September 25, 2026. The monitoring agency reported no deviation from the objects of the issue. There was no utilization of funds during the quarter. The entire amount of Rs. 2,100 crore remains unutilized. The funds are deployed in term deposits with State Bank of India and ICICI Bank, and in monitoring and escrow accounts with Axis Bank. The Board of Directors reviewed the report on November 12, 2026.

attchmntText: Elevate Campuses Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Elevate Campuses Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a net profit of 1,68.54 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the net profit was 329.85 million. The board also approved the shifting of the registered office from Naman Midtown, Unit No 902-906, 9th Floor, Tower B, Senapati Bapat Marg, Lower Parel, Mumbai to Unit No 1701, 17th Floor, One Unity Center, Senapati Bapat Marg, Prabhadevi, Mumbai, effective December 01, 2026. The board meeting was held on November 12, 2026. Limited review reports were issued by S R B C & Co LLP.

attchmntText: Intimation regarding participation of the Company s Representatives at Institutional Investor Meeting - JM Financial Annual India Conference - India Xchange 2026
voiceSummary: Elevate Campuses Limited has intimated that its representatives will participate in the JM Financial Annual India Conference - India Xchange 2026. The meeting is scheduled for Tuesday, November 17, 2026, in Mumbai. The event will feature one-on-one and group meetings. The company confirmed that no unpublished price sensitive information will be shared during this investor interaction. The schedule may change due to exigencies. This intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The notice is also uploaded on the company website.

attchmntText: Elevate Campuses Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Elevate Campuses Limited has scheduled an earnings conference call to discuss the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The call is set for Monday, November 16, 2026, at 12 p.m. It will be conducted via dial-in audio conference from Mumbai. The company confirms that no unpublished price sensitive information will be shared during this interaction. Dial-in details and registration links are available in the attached annexure and on the company website. The schedule is subject to change due to exigencies.
